purpose: Define install-time dependency validation using explicit declared dependency identities and compatibility constraints, with hard failure rather than silent auto-enablement or invention.

topics.name: Install Dependency Validation
topics.purpose: Define install-time dependency validation using explicit declared dependency identities and compatibility constraints, with hard failure rather than silent auto-enablement or invention.

semantics.dependency_rule: Each required dependency resolves exact canonical/package identity and compatible version/profile.
semantics.auto_rule: Missing dependency is never silently auto-enabled or invented.
semantics.install_rule: Installer may install an explicitly requested dependency only under an explicit install plan/operation.
semantics.prune_rule: Explicit pruning/negative selection may remove optional components only if closure remains valid.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing/incompatible required dependency hard-fails the affected install plan.
semantics.remediation_rule: Failure emits one concise deterministic remediation line where possible.
semantics.trace_rule: Validation records exact missing/incompatible dependency refs.

invariants.rule: Library discovery and installation are explicit source/package lifecycle semantics; filesystem presence, discovery order or installation never silently changes canonical identity, enables dependencies or activates runtime effects.

hard_gates.condition: optional prune breaks required closure silently

references.purpose: Install dependency rules align with no-auto-enable boot semantics.
